label: Digit 0 input late in the original phase (context-gated)
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.01% of steps). It fires almost only on input token 0 during the original phase at positions 5-8 (87% of activation mass, 79% of active steps), plus weak activity at the <DEL> step (7.5% of mass). It never fires in the copy phase or at t<4. Most input-0 steps do not trigger it, though (precision about 2%), so some context gates it: it is enriched when the sequence starts with 3/j/g/i and when the previous token is e/w/d/c. Top examples look like 3 j ... d e 0. Adding those context conditions brings precision up to about 0.4 but cuts recall to about 0.3. Unpredicted activations are mostly weak 0 or <DEL> steps in other contexts. The gating context is not captured cleanly.
